entities.summary: Randolph Richard Bullock is an American former professional football player who was a placekicker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies, and was recognized as the nation's best college football kicker and a consensus All-American. He was selected by the Houston Texans in the fifth round of the 2012 NFL draft, after winning college football's Lou Groza Award.
